description: Copper is a Google Workspace-oriented CRM with a RESTful Developer API.
auth_notes: API token plus user email sent in headers; OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant preferred for partner integrations, with a single developer/v1/all scope.
gate_detail: API keys are self-generated by users in System settings, but need a Copper account (pricing shows free trial only). OAuth requires registering your app by contacting Copper to receive client_id and client_secret.
api_scope: RESTful JSON Developer API covering most Copper resources, with Postman collection; OAuth scope grants full read and modify access to the user's records.
mcp_notes: No MCP server mentioned in the sources.
blocker_detail: Multi-user OAuth requires contacting Copper to register the app; API keys avoid this but need a paid or trial account.

evidence.quote: API Keys are suitable for individual users, while OAuth2.0 is the preferred approach for partner integrations.
To generate an API token, in the Copper web app go to System settings > API Keys and click the 'GENERATE API KEY'
To register your application, contact us
provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to access most Copper resources.
Start free, no credit card required.

uncertainties: usecopper.com sources (S3, S4) describe a different product with sk_test_ keys and were ignored.
Whether an API key is available on a free trial only or requires a paid plan is not stated.
Webhooks and sandbox are not covered.
Whether OAuth registration is gated or approved beyond contacting Copper is unclear.
